notes: P&L usability: personal P&L and guild (Capital House) portfolio now have a ticker filter box and a scrollable list. The per-position bar chart no longer crams every holding into a fixed 180px (which collapsed row height and overprinted the symbol labels into an unreadable column); it now grows to a fixed readable row height and the panel scrolls, with the +/-% scale pinned in its own header so it stays put while the bars scroll. Search narrows the visible list and bars only; KPIs, net worth, and the allocation donut still reflect the full portfolio.
